entries.english:
1291, date and place uncertain. — Dominik von Passauerschlag gives two parts of the tithe from his estates in Passern to the Cistercian monastery of Hohenfurt.

XLII. Human affairs quickly slip from memory unless they are made lasting by writing or the testimony of witnesses. Let present and future generations know that I, Dominik, wish to sow on earth from the things bestowed on me by God, so that I may joyfully gather sheaves in heaven. Therefore, inspired by the Lord, I have given two parts of the tithe from all my estates in Passern to the house of the Blessed Virgin Mary at Hohenfurt, of the Cistercian Order, to be held in perpetuity during my lifetime and after my death by whomever those estates may later pass to, for the remission of my sins. So that this may remain valid and not be disturbed in the future by any claim, I have delivered this charter to the brethren who continually serve God in the aforesaid house, strengthened by the seal of my noble lord of Rosenberg affixed to it.

Enacted in the year of the Lord 1291.

Seals: Two seals on parchment strips, in white wax. The well-preserved equestrian seal of Heinrich von Rosenberg, described more fully in no. XXXIII; only the upper left part remains of Dominik’s small seal, showing the remnant of an S-shaped design and part of the legend. Millauer, p. 107, no. 24.
